signatures.description: Implement a Hi-Z occlusion-culling pass in Node: build a conservative max-depth mip pyramid from the previous frame's depth buffer, reproject the camera, and test instance AABBs against the pyramid so that visible geometry is never culled while occluded geometry still is. Correctly handle reversed-Z depth, non-power-of-two targets, and camera motion that invalidates stale pyramid texels at the screen borders. Prove the conservativeness invariant on adversarial scenes (thin occluders, depth-discontinuous silhouettes, near/far extremes) with tests rather than eyeballing screenshots.
